The complete transaction list is available. I will now retrieve the exact contact relationship labels and paginate through all contact results to identify the roommates.

```python
contact_relationships = apis.phone.show_contact_relationships(access_token=phone_access_token)
print('Relationship labels:', contact_relationships)
roommates = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, relationship='roommates', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    roommates.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print(roommates)
```
